name: Bucket Size Computation
aliases: Bucket Texture Construction via Auxiliary Texture
definition: Computes the Buckets Texture storing the position of the last voxel of each bucket. Computed in two steps because direct fragment shader computation is impossible due to lack of relationship between textures and vertex shader inefficiency for texture fetches.
summary: Bucket Size Computation efficiently identifies bucket boundaries on the GPU by splitting detection into fragment and vertex shader steps, avoiding costly vertex shader texture fetches.
